verdict.rationale: The story asks whether Jina Reader publishes its own llms.txt or agent-oriented docs that an agent can be pointed at. The probe found https://jina.ai/llms.txt returns 404, and all candidate OpenAPI paths also returned 404. Reader's ability to turn other URLs into LLM-friendly text, and its official MCP server, are different capabilities and are not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
